$comment: Documented satellite/instrument outages and anomalies from NASA and NOAA operational notices. Input to scripts/harmonize/fit.mjs (coverage audit). An entry never flags data on its own: a day is flagged only when the detection records themselves show the loss (cross-satellite or climatological evidence, src/data/v2/coverage.ts). A detected gap that overlaps an entry here is labelled 'confirmed'; one that does not is 'suspected'. Dates are UTC days and are the widest span given by the cited notices. Collected 2026-11-15 from the linked pages via web search; add new notices here and refit. Each event carries a verification record from re-reading its primary notice (2026-11-15).

events.title: Terra MODIS power supply 2 failure; science data resumed on power supply 1 in early July

verification.note: MCST weekly report gives the power-supply anomaly at 03:56:08 GMT 2001-06-15; no recovery date on that page. End 2001-07-03 from the Earthdata forum post, which now returns HTTP 404 (not re-verifiable).

events.title: Terra safe mode during an inclination adjustment manoeuvre; MODIS back in science mode 2016-02-24

verification.note: Earthdata notice: safe mode 2016-02-18; no data acquired 2016-02-19 through 2016-02-27. End corrected from 2016-02-24 to 2016-02-27.

events.title: Aqua safe mode after a power controller swap; MODIS nominal again 2022-04-17

verification.note: MCST: safe mode 17:59:08Z 2022-03-31; MODIS nominal for all bands 03:00Z 2022-04-17. The LAADS page states no dates.

events.title: Terra constellation-exit (orbit lowering) manoeuvres; MODIS data outage

verification.note: Earthdata notice: Terra MODIS data outage 2022-10-10 through 2022-10-19. End corrected from 2022-10-22 (taken from a NOAA notice of 10-12 to 10-21) to the NASA dates; the records show zero Terra detections until 2022-10-23, flagged from cross-satellite evidence.

events.title: Suomi NPP safe mode; notice window 2022-07-26 to 2022-08-20. The FIRMS records have no S-NPP detections 2022-07-27 to 2022-08-10; detections resume 2022-08-11

verification.note: Earthdata notice: began 2022-07-26, resolved 2022-08-20 (no times). Provenance audit 2026-11-15: the FIRMS science-quality archive (US) has S-NPP rows again from 2022-08-11, so the notice window is wider than the data gap; the detected gap (2022-07-27 to 2022-08-10) comes from the records, not from this notice.

events.title: Suomi NPP safe mode, about 01:56 UTC 2023-07-26 to 16:50 UTC 2023-07-27

verification.note: Earthdata notice: gap began 01:56:11 UTC 2023-07-26; marked resolved 2023-08-16 (resolution date, not end of the data gap).

events.title: Suomi NPP GPS anomaly: degraded VIIRS geolocation, forward processing suspended until 2024-06-05

verification.note: Earthdata notice: anomaly from ~22:23 UTC 2024-05-25, resolved 2024-06-05.

events.title: Suomi NPP GPS anomaly: VIIRS forward processing suspended, normal production from 2024-07-16

verification.note: Earthdata notice: 21:46 UTC 2024-07-09 to GPS recovery 17:42 UTC 2024-07-16.

events.title: Suomi NPP safe hold; VIIRS science data 05:28 UTC 2024-07-24 to 07:00 UTC 2024-08-01 not recoverable

verification.note: Earthdata notice gives the spacecraft outage 05:28-18:22 UTC 2024-07-24 only; VIIRS science data stayed unavailable until VIIRS returned to operations (NOAA OSPO: 2024-07-29, from a search summary, not re-checked). End corrected from 2024-08-01 (Copernicus notice) to 2024-07-29.

events.title: Suomi NPP GPS anomaly; VIIRS data gap 21:12 UTC 2024-11-02 to 17:36 UTC 2024-11-06

verification.note: Earthdata notice: data gap 21:12 UTC 2024-11-02 to 17:36 UTC 2024-11-06.
